uncited: They set themselves apart from sibling methods by treating grid deformations and topological weights as learnable parameters, enabling the resolution of topological ambiguities and the production of high-fidelity surfaces directly from neural network outputs [977-mise-meshing-isosurfaces-by-extracting.md][3669-flexicubes.md].
This family inherits the discretized domain traversal and surface determination mechanisms from [Isosurface extraction](30-isosurface-extraction.md).
Early work focused on static extraction from NeRF density fields [4104-nerf-density-field-mesh-extraction.md].
The introduction of differentiable extraction, such as MISE [977-mise-meshing-isosurfaces-by-extracting.md], allowed for adaptive sampling.

Subsequent developments like FlexiCubes [3669-flexicubes.md] and Differentiable Marching Cubes [9774-differentiable-marching-cubes.md] enabled end-to-end training of geometry by making the extraction process differentiable with respect to grid parameters.

Ground truth generation methods [3820-ground-truth-generation-for-neural-marching-cubes.md] were developed to train CNNs for fast inference, replacing the differentiable optimization step with a learned approximation.
